title: Discrete Financial Penny-Drift & Conservation Invariants
failure_mode: Cumulative penny-drift roundoff error violating Conservation of Money and arbitrary last-element remainder dumping
invariant_guarantee: The sum of all discrete currency allocations must strictly equal the total input amount to zero cents of drift (sum(allocations) == total), implementing the Hare-Niemeyer Largest Remainder method with deterministic tie-breaking
